summary_en: Waseda Gakushukenyukai will acquire 1.10 million shares (10.89% of outstanding shares) at the closing price of ¥1,289 on October 26, 2026 via ToSTNeT-3 on October 27, 2026, with a maximum acquisition amount of ¥1.418 billion. The acquisition addresses founder and controlling shareholder Toshio Yoshihara's intention to sell part of his shareholding and serves as a source for restricted stock awards to employees.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On October 26, 2026, Waseda Gakushukenyukai's board of directors authorized the acquisition of up to 1.10 million treasury shares via an off-hours trading (ToSTNeT-3) transaction. The acquisition will proceed at the closing price of ¥1,289 on the same day, with a maximum outlay of ¥1.418 billion, representing 10.89% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock).

The company received notification from founder, chairman, and principal controlling shareholder Toshio Yoshihara that he intends to sell a portion of his shareholding in the company. Rather than permit such sales to occur on the open market where they could negatively impact the stock price, the board determined that treasury stock acquisition would mitigate market impact while providing strategic benefits. The acquired shares will serve as a source for the company's restricted stock award program offered to executives and employees and support more flexible capital allocation and improved capital efficiency.

Fairness safeguards include the use of ToSTNeT-3 at the daily closing price and the exclusion of Yoshihara from board deliberations and voting due to his material interest. The company has confirmed that the transaction complies with its disclosed governance policy on transactions with controlling shareholders and that minority shareholders' interests are protected. Results of the transaction will be announced after trading concludes on October 27, 2026.
